purpose: Query-plan exploration only; no performance claims or benchmark timings.
baseline: SEARCH t USING INDEX idx_tasks_payment_settled (payment_status=? AND settled_at>?)

variants.name: amount-only
variants.sql:
CREATE INDEX candidate ON tasks(bounty_amount) WHERE payment_status = 'settled' AND bounty_network IN ('eip155:8453') AND settled_at IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(escrow_status, '') != 'refunded' AND (length(COALESCE(NULLIF(escrow_release_tx_hash, ''), NULLIF(payment_tx_hash, ''))) = 66 AND substr(COALESCE(NULLIF(escrow_release_tx_hash, ''), NULLIF(payment_tx_hash, '')), 1, 2) = '0x' AND NOT (lower(substr(COALESCE(NULLIF(escrow_release_tx_hash, ''), NULLIF(payment_tx_hash, '')), 3)) GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'))
plan: SEARCH t USING INDEX idx_tasks_payment_settled (payment_status=? AND settled_at>?)
